content: Four weeks ago, San Francisco 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan was involved in an accident near downtown Palo Alto. At the time Shanahan said only that the accident was his fault. But during a recent press conference he shared more details about the incident, including the fact that he had his Tesla’s Autopilot engaged at the time. Shanahan was not passing the buck, however, saying it was his fault regardless of whether or not Autopilot was engaged. > “I’ve had Autopilot for nine years, so I’m pretty comfortable with it and, you know, who knows what happened when I turned around? Whether it malfunctioned or whether I knocked it off? That’s something I don’t know yet. But regardless, that’s… it is always your fault, whether you’re on Autopilot or not. You can’t take your eyes off the road. It’s a partnership driving, you don’t just turn it over to a computer.” [Media: https://www.threads.com/@maiocconbcs/post/DbzTCr5mokd] Over the years Tesla’s Autopilot has been linked to hundreds of crashes and dozens of deaths, some of which have resulted in hundreds of millions of dollars in legal settlements.

chineseContent: 四个星期前，旧金山 49 人队主教练凯尔·沙纳汉 (Kyle Shanahan) 在帕洛阿尔托市中心附近发生了一起事故。当时沙纳汉只表示事故是他的错。但在最近的一次新闻发布会上，他分享了有关该事件的更多细节，包括当时他启用了特斯拉的自动驾驶仪。然而，沙纳汉并没有推卸责任，他表示，无论自动驾驶仪是否启用，这都是他的错。 > “我已经使用 Autopilot 九年了，所以我对它很满意，你知道，谁知道当我转身时发生了什么？是它发生故障还是我把它撞坏了？这是我还不知道的事情。但无论如何，这……这始终是你的错，无论你是否使用 Autopilot。你不能将视线从道路上移开。这是一种合作驾驶，你不能把它交给电脑。” [媒体：https://www.threads.com/@maiocconbcs/post/DbzTCr5mokd] 多年来，特斯拉的 Autopilot 与数百起撞车事故和数十人死亡有关，其中一些事故导致了数亿美元的法律和解。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
